GRE Tunnel Resource Delete GRE Tunnel
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/greTunnels/:Id

Deletes the GRE tunnel information for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
Id
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the GRE tunnel.

Responses
​
